node.title: WCL ell=1 weight-6 even-norm divisor descent
node.statement: Every reduced signed weight-6 relation at an exact order-512 root has a unique parity locator F(X)=E(X^2)-X B(X^2), with E monic cubic and deg B<=1, and exists exactly when G(Y)=E(Y)^2-YB(Y)^2 divides Y^256-1. The six remainder coefficients form a five-variable integer ideal that is the unit ideal over Q, so one nonzero integer Nullstellensatz certificate restricts all survivors to finitely many characteristics. No certificate or official exclusion is claimed.
